question: The word "contaminated" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3)** i.e. Made impure or infected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contaminated"** means something that has been made impure or infected by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance. (प्रदूषित किया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The water in the river was contaminated by industrial waste.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Made impure or infected**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Clean and pure** (साफ और शुद्ध):

 
 
• **Example: **We need to drink clean and pure water to stay healthy.
 
 
 
• **Burned completely** (पूरी तरह से जलाया हुआ):
 
 
• **Example: **The old documents were burned completely to prevent misuse.
 
 
 
• **Recycled safely** (सुरक्षित रूप से पुन:प्रयुक्त):
 
 
• **Example: **The plastic bottles were recycled safely into new products.
 
 

49:T9fb,

The correct answer is: **Option (2)** i.e. Harmful and dangerous.
